sourceShape.classification: A directory-depth loop repeatedly invokes an ordered linear child-directory prefix search. The target contains no literal collection Contains invocation. This identification is not a false-positive adjudication.
sourceShape.costModel: Directory work is the sum of scanned sibling-list prefixes along the traversed directory path, plus string searching/comparisons and any newly created path-prefix strings/nodes. For the captured normal fixtures every populated directory has at most one child directory, so no wide-sibling multiplier is demonstrated.

facts: Each filesystem instance constructs one DirectoryNode root at slash.
Add checks projectItem for null, delegates path normalization to the inherited method, constructs a FileNode, and calls the real DirectoryNode.AddFile.
GetItem and EnumerateItems normalize through the same inherited method and call the real root.
The DirectoryNode is a private field; no directory-list access or mutation is exposed by this filesystem's public methods.
Eleven Fact methods were named and read, not run.
Three methods call IsRecompilationSupported and do not populate the filesystem. Eight methods call IsItemValid once each.
Six methods populate files, with 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, and 3 Add calls respectively: eleven literal Add calls across one invocation of each source method.
The actual added paths are only /Views/Home/Index.cstml, /Views/Home/_ViewImports.cstml, and /Views/_ViewImports.cstml. The spelling cstml is preserved from the actual fixture.

Under the normal isolated Fact-instance lifecycle, at most three files, two directory edges, and one immediate child directory per populated parent are produced. The property initializer is per constructed test object, not a shared static filesystem.

ChecksumValidator.IsItemValid performs one primary GetItem and, if its preceding checks succeed, one GetItem for each non-primary checksum. The largest captured cases have a primary plus two imports, so at most three direct GetItem calls per method invocation are source-supported.

Twelve direct filesystem lookups are source-derived across the six populated validation cases when following their explicit valid/invalid early-exit paths; this is static source accounting, not an observed runtime count.

contractsAtCapturedSourceBoundary.directoryMembership: FindSubDirectory scans the parent's mutable ordered List<DirectoryNode> and returns the first child whose path suffix, beginning at parent.Path.Length and of child.Path.Length minus that start index, matches the requested path with StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase. This is path-segment prefix matching including the child's slash, not reference equality or exact full-string hash membership.
contractsAtCapturedSourceBoundary.fileMembership: GetItem scans files in insertion order. It compares from directory.Path.Length for requestedPath.Length minus directory.Path.Length characters using OrdinalIgnoreCase, then returns the first matching FileNode.ProjectItem. There is no separate equal-file-name-length check. An exact filename dictionary would not by itself establish preservation of that source contract.
contractsAtCapturedSourceBoundary.casingAndRepresentation: Stored node Path strings retain the representation from the first creation. FileNode.Path is the normalized path supplied by the owning filesystem, while the returned RazorProjectItem reference is the original object. Matching is ordinal case-insensitive, not OS/culture-default equality.
contractsAtCapturedSourceBoundary.normalizationInsideDirectoryNode: GetDirectoryPath uses LastIndexOf slash and Substring through that slash; GetOrAddDirectory appends one trailing slash when missing and searches slash boundaries from the current directory path length. DirectoryNode does not itself call System.IO.Path or implement additional canonicalization.
contractsAtCapturedSourceBoundary.inheritedNormalizationBoundary: VirtualRazorProjectFileSystem delegates to RazorProjectFileSystem.NormalizeAndEnsureValidPath for Add, GetItem, and EnumerateItems. Bounded exact-name searches over src C# files in both immutable roles returned the two call-site files, not a captured implementation. Exact inherited null/empty/backslash/relative/dot-segment handling and its exception behavior remain unqualified; no absence outside that search scope is claimed.
contractsAtCapturedSourceBoundary.directoryOrder: GetOrAddDirectory reuses the first matching existing child or appends a newly created child with the full prefix through the next slash. Existing siblings are not reordered.
contractsAtCapturedSourceBoundary.duplicates: Files.Add retains duplicate file entries and their order; GetItem returns the first matching entry. Normal Add reuses case-insensitively matching directories. The publicly accessible mutable List properties could be changed directly by another typed caller; the captured owning filesystem does not expose them or do such mutation. No deduplication contract is introduced.
contractsAtCapturedSourceBoundary.mutationAndIdentity: AddFile appends to the selected node's Files and sets FileNode.Directory to that node. FileNode.Directory and ProjectItem have setters. No auxiliary index, snapshot, cache, lock, or read-only collection is maintained.
contractsAtCapturedSourceBoundary.enumeration: DirectoryNode.EnumerateItems is deferred and recursively yields the current directory's files in insertion order, followed by each child subtree in child insertion order. It yields the stored ProjectItem references and retains duplicates. VirtualRazorProjectFileSystem performs normalization and directory resolution before returning that iterator. Existing List enumerator behavior governs mutation during enumeration; no concurrent-mutation or exception-timing experiment was run.
exceptionsAndMissingResults: AddFile, GetDirectory, and GetItem reject a path lacking the node's OrdinalIgnoreCase prefix with InvalidOperationException and their existing File ... does not belong to ... message.
A missing child with createIfNotExists false returns null; GetDirectory propagates that, and the filesystem maps it to Enumerable.Empty.
GetItem maps a missing directory or file to NotFoundProjectItem with Exists false. That object's PhysicalPath and Read throw NotSupportedException.

Private GetOrAddDirectory has a Debug.Assert for nonempty input and then indexes the last character. Those source statements are not proof of any selected Debug configuration, runtime validation, or reachable invalid-input behavior.
String, List, and inherited-normalizer exceptions are not caught or translated in DirectoryNode. No exception behavior was changed or experimentally verified.

history.qualification: Bounded eight-entry --follow queries returned four entries in each role. No historical commit was used as the current Default, and no historical product file was added to the whole-file budget.

materialityAssessment.sourceFinding: The nested ordered linear directory scan is real, but the normal producer cohorts captured here do not demonstrate wide directory siblings or a large tree. A nontrivial performance opportunity has not been established.
materialityAssessment.whyNotLocationOnly: Disposition rests on actual Add producers, fixed actual file paths, directory topology, consumer call sites, per-test source call counts, and unchanged current Default bytes, not on the helper being in a test directory.

evidenceAndExecution.streamLimitQualification: Full binary streams are retained. The declared 32MiB per-stream limit is checked after capture, not used to truncate bytes.
evidenceAndExecution.observerQualification: CIM snapshots with 50ms sleeps are sampled evidence only; short-lived, intersample, reparented, or otherwise unobserved descendants can be missed. Actual creation-bound direct handle waits are independently recorded. No global process idleness or complete descendant absence claim.
evidenceAndExecution.toolPresentationLimits: Some large initial diagnostic/source displays exceeded the tool preview limit. Complete owned source streams and decoded-display outer streams are retained. The initial oversized policy diagnostic is not treated as source-byte evidence.
evidenceAndExecution.localGuidanceQualification: Three raw filesystem guidance copies are separately identified in source command results. Their filesystem bytes are not silently represented as Git object bytes; both roles additionally have full raw commit-bound copies of all three guidance files.
evidenceAndExecution.codeIntelligenceQualification: No branch-safe resolved graph was used. The task identified the configured Bluebird scope as unrelated; local language-server results from the reserved checkout were not treated as current Default evidence. Exact-name inventories are textual, not a semantic/reflection-completeness proof.
